title: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane of which Nephalia and its undead are described in this guide.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A water-defined, commerce-minded province of Innistrad known for woodcraft, vampires and merchants.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose absence has stirred the dead and whose role as psychopomp once shepherded souls to the Aether.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that keeps order in Nephalian towns and trains cathars.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: The vampire bloodline of Runo, with its ancestral manor in Drunau.

entities.name: Runo
entities.description: Progenitor of the Stromkirk line, who secretly patronized Nephalian woodcraft while removing its forests.

entities.name: Krallenhorde
entities.description: Werewolves that prey on travelers and merchants in Nephalia.

entities.name: Nebelgast
entities.description: A spirit-mist that rolls in and out with the tide, bringing geists, most active at Selhoff.

entities.name: metzalar
entities.description: Nephalia's merchants, the glue that binds the province together.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: The largest of Nephalia's three port towns, at the mouth of the Silburlind River.

entities.name: Drunau
entities.description: Port town where the Stromkirk have their ancestral manor.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A foggy southern port where the Nebelgast is most active.

entities.name: Silver Beach
entities.description: Nephalia's coastline, with sands rich in granular silver.

entities.name: Erdwal
entities.description: A network of underground trenches linking Havengul, Drunau and Selhoff, home to a black market.

entities.name: Morkrut
entities.description: A marsh near Selhoff filled with banshees and malevolent geists.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: A small fort in Havengul where new cathars are trained.

entities.name: Arms of Avacyn
entities.description: Outposts of cathars sent in small groups to neighboring towns.

entities.name: Ludevic of Ulm
entities.description: The most influential Nephalian merchant, a wheezing, reclusive alchemist.

entities.name: Fauchard
entities.description: A secretive order of human vampire hunters in Drunau.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: A reclusive astronomer in a tower on the Silver Beach who charts the moon.

entities.name: skaberen
entities.description: Necro-alchemists who build skaabs and are viewed as blasphemers.

entities.name: ghoulcallers
entities.description: Black-mana necromancers who call forth the dead from graveyards.

entities.name: geists
entities.description: Ghosts of the human dead existing between the material and Aethereal realms.

events.summary: Runo, using glamers and fortune, removed Nephalia's woodlands while turning the humans into artisans of wood.
events.quote: Runo, progenitor of the Stromkirk line, was crafty in his removal of the woodlands.

events.summary: Stromkirk and merchants tolerate skaberen and ghoulcallers as long as their work stays rumor.
events.quote: so their arcane trinkets and dark services are tolerated as long as they remain only rumors at the local taverns.

events.summary: The Church of Avacyn establishes the Elgaud Grounds to train cathars, who are sent out as Arms of Avacyn.
events.quote: A contingent of the Avacyn Church long ago established a small fort here known as the Elgaud Grounds

events.summary: Bodysnatchers in Havengul sell disinterred corpses to ghoulcallers and skaberen through the Erdwal.
events.quote: Havengul, having the largest human population, is rife with bodysnatchers who disinter corpses

events.summary: Vampires of Drunau keep humans with delicious blood as pampered livestock.
events.quote: Humans who possess especially delicious blood are treated like the most precious livestock

events.summary: The Stromkirk hunt down Fauchard hunters they discover, though Runo tolerates them to a degree.
events.quote: Runo knows of them and tolerates them to some degree

events.summary: The Erdwal originated as defensive trenches and grew into a trade network and black market.
events.quote: originated as trenches created by Nephalians in each of the major cities of Havengul, Drunau, and Selhoff for resisting zombie and werewolf attacks.

events.summary: Jenrik studies the moon from his tower, feared by the Stromkirk.
events.quote: Jenrik, the astronomer, mysteriously conducts his work studying the stars

events.summary: With Avacyn absent, the dead are more easily stirred and benevolent geists appear alongside malevolent ones.
events.quote: In Avacyn's absence, the malevolent spirits were counterbalanced by the appearance of many benevolent and neutral geists

relations.quote: the Stromkirk vampires under their progenitor, Runo
Innistrad denizens interested in commerce are attracted to Nephalia
the Fauchard destroy the vampires whom the Stromkirk consider to be most crass and distasteful
The most influential of Nephalia's merchants is Ludevic of Ulm, a wheezing and reclusive alchemist.
Nephalia has three main port towns along the coast: Havengul, Drunau, and Selhoff.
